_note: Key path: planet_house_changes[*].body -> planet_house_changes[*].relocated_house -> planet_house_changes[*].movement_type. Covers the 10 core planets (Sun through Pluto) explicitly, plus a BODY-level 'fallback' for North_Node, South_Node, Lilith_BML, and custom asteroids so this file stays bounded instead of exploding to 30+ body keys. Relocated houses 1-12 are all present under each body. Movement types actually present per house are restricted to what is astronomically reachable: angular houses (1, 4, 7, 10) can only be entered via same_house, newly_angular, or house_changed -- never leaves_angular, since leaves_angular requires the RELOCATED house to NOT be angular. Non-angular houses (2,3,5,6,8,9,11,12) can only be entered via same_house, leaves_angular, or house_changed -- never newly_angular. This is not an omission; it mirrors engine.location_services._movement_type's actual branching (see CAPABILITY_INVENTORY.md / LOCATION_EVIDENCE_RECORD_CONTRACT.md). The house-level 'fallback' leaf under each body covers the impossible combination gracefully if selector logic ever looks one up anyway. 'unknown' movement_type is NOT nested under a specific house number: if relocated_house data is genuinely missing, there is no valid house integer to build this key path from in the first place. Handle 'unknown' once per body (see each body's 'unknown' key, sibling to the house number keys) rather than per house. DO NOT invent moves_public / moves_private / moves_relational / moves_operational anywhere in this file -- that is deferred house-domain taxonomy per BLOCK_SCHEMA.md Block Family 3 and PROSE_PURPOSE_REVIEW.md's house_shift_blocks.json section; it belongs in a future selector-owned table keyed on the raw natal_house/relocated_house integers already present in every leaf's requires_evidence, not baked into the engine or this file. The per-house '_note' below quotes EVIDENCE_TO_MEANING_MATRIX.md's existing per-house theme language purely as descriptive flavor for that single house number -- this is reuse of already-authored content, not a new 4-bucket domain classification. same_house is not empty evidence -- PROSE_PURPOSE_REVIEW.md is explicit that continuity is worth naming, especially when the same body also has a relocated_angle_contacts entry.

fallback._note: Covers North_Node, South_Node, Lilith_BML, and any custom asteroid's relocated house placement, without exploding this grid to 30+ body keys. These bodies have no natal_modifiers entry, so leaves here should not reach for a condition qualifier that does not exist.
